geometric_audit.method: SQLite integrity_check in immutable read-only mode; original stored WKB hash and OGR/GEOS validity without repair. GeoJSON gets source file SHA and a separately identified read-only OGR WKB fingerprint. Counts are occurrences, not unique sectors.
geometric_audit.relationship_note: Source linkage with different WKB does not establish geometric identity. No tolerance-based transfer, merging, normalization of files, or geometric recalculation.
